summary: A comprehensive cold-start playbook for launching a creative strategist career from zero distribution. Provides 3 paths (Unsolicited Audit, Content System Audit, Portfolio-From-Scratch), recommends running Path A + B simultaneously, maps all existing Antigravity workflows to the cold-start problem, provides specific Week 1 daily actions, and addresses the common traps that kill momentum. Built from Lynch (campaign architecture), Cole (client acquisition), and Wiebe (service positioning) expertise.
